baseline_evidence.assessment: Independent source-23 INITIAL factual acceptance of inspected unchanged game content; no new lexical/source authority or C8 board approval.

child_safety.assessment: I inspected all 85 quick payloads, 352 recipe explanations, 252 displayed concepts and 49 extension associations as existing game text. The household, school, family, nature, cultural, sport and culinary material contains no explicit sexual, abusive or graphic text. Named historical conflicts appear as non-graphic associations. Ordinary human anatomy and Romanian forest brown-bear senses are intended. The culinary pairs describe dish ideas and carry preparation qualifiers; they are not complete cooking instructions. This text judgment does not certify current remote pages, advertising, living-person updates or health/nutrition guidance.

independence.signature_kind: Reviewer-issued UTC declaration; no cryptographic identity attestation is claimed.

baseline_evidence.limits: Fresh INITIAL factual review of exact unchanged C7-to-C8 rail content only. Every semantic item was inspected, source-23 rows and effective historical reference arrays were independently compared, and current KG snapshots, authored definitions, Render hashes, bindings and bounded progression were independently reconstructed in Python. No remote page was fetched, and no source-body availability, new lexical approval, native audit, save-restore replay, build, gate, export, HTTP qualification, proposal, installation, final approval, release, pin update or landing is claimed. C8 peer review bodies/verdicts were never read; quality path/hash descriptors in source and registration inputs were data only. Integrator preparation receipts were hash checked and not executed. Secondary and commercial sources remain historical evidence. Legacy aliases, degree and Python/runtime bindings remain historical provenance. The 85 inherited KG concept reference arrays that are empty remain empty and supply no new external definition authority. The sole new science pack row is outside these unchanged-rail judgments; biology, ordinary brown-bear, normal human anatomy, unmeasured greu/recognition calibration, secondary-source limits and global-stock scope remain for the separate board landing review.
baseline_evidence.pending_cascade: Independent INITIAL pair must precede native proposals, actual audits and fresh same-role final decisions. This package contains no final artifact.
